title: Exploring Response Uncertainty in MLLMs: An Empirical Evaluation under Misleading Scenarios
reasoning: The paper focuses on the robustness and consistency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) when faced with misleading cues. The evaluation categories include perception, reasoning, and mastery tasks (such as counting, OCR, and academic knowledge), and there is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
